review:
Fisherman's Luck is Wazdan's take on the fishing-collector theme. Gainer symbols are its version of the fisherman: they stay in play for up to 10 spins, gathering every Cash and Jackpot value on the reels beneath them, and multipliers can raise their value.

In Free Spins, Gainers stay until the end of the round, Gain Boosters extend them, and Gain to Infinity keeps them active throughout. Cash Out symbols on the top reels net the values below and pay them out. The Grand Jackpot is 2,500x the bet; Wazdan rates it medium volatility with a 96.13% RTP. A steadier alternative to the Big Bass style of game.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Free demo available on the Wazdan website
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
